name: @papercupai/cloudflare-stack
description: Provision a full Cloudflare backend (Pages + Workers + D1 + R2 + KV) for a forked harness. Ships setup/teardown/verify scripts that create real resources in the forker's account and template the harness's project files with the new IDs.
author: Papercusp

accountId.title: Cloudflare account ID
accountId.description: 32-hex-char ID from your Cloudflare dashboard URL (dash.cloudflare.com → right sidebar). Different per forker — never travels with snapshots.

byoCloudflareToken.title: Cloudflare API token
byoCloudflareToken.description: API token with these scopes: Pages:Edit, Workers Scripts:Edit, D1:Edit, R2:Edit, Workers KV Storage:Edit, User Details:Read. Create at dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens. Stripped from snapshots; you must paste a fresh one at fork time.

projectName.title: Pages project name
projectName.description: Pages project name (lowercase, hyphens, ≤54 chars). Becomes the `*.pages.dev` subdomain. Leave blank to default to the harness slug.

workerName.title: Worker script name
workerName.description: Worker script name (lowercase, hyphens, ≤64 chars). Becomes the `*.workers.dev` subdomain. Leave blank to default to `<harness-slug>-api`.

d1DatabaseName.title: D1 database name
d1DatabaseName.description: D1 database display name. Leave blank to default to `<harness-slug>-db`.

r2BucketName.title: R2 bucket name
r2BucketName.description: R2 bucket name (lowercase, hyphens, 3–63 chars, account-globally-unique). Leave blank to default to `<harness-slug>-assets`.

kvNamespaceTitle.title: KV namespace title
kvNamespaceTitle.description: KV namespace title (display name only; substrate-generated ID becomes the binding). Leave blank to default to `<harness-slug>-sessions`.

skipResources.title: Skip resources
skipResources.description: Skip specific resources. Useful if your harness only needs some of them (e.g. Pages-only static site).

byoCloudflareToken.ui:help: Create at dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens with the scopes listed above.

setup.description: Creates Pages project, Worker, D1 database, R2 bucket, and KV namespace in your Cloudflare account. Templates the harness's project files (wrangler.toml.tmpl, .env.production.tmpl, etc.) with the new IDs. Idempotent: safe to re-run.

roles.whenUseful: Consult when SPEC additions specifically touch Cloudflare resources — new R2/D1/KV/DO bindings, edge routing changes, worker-vs-pages decisions, edge secrets, or CF tier-limit boundaries. Use INSTEAD of the generic infra-reviewer when the change is clearly Cloudflare-specific. Skip for product changes that don't touch data persistence or edge config.
